topics.title: Classification of farm animals
topics.notes: Classification based on: 1. Digestive system (a) Ruminants e.g. sheep, goat, cattle (b) Non-ruminants (monogastrics) e.g. poultry, pigs (c) Non-ruminant herbivores e.g. rabbits, grasscutter, guinea pigs. 2. Concept of traditional (cattle, sheep, goat) and non-traditional farm animals (rabbit, grasscutter, snails).
